entities.name: Victor Alekseyevich Vaziulin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Victor Alekseyevich Vaziulin was a Soviet and Russian philosopher. He became famous for his deep knowledge of Karl Marx's work as well as for further developing Marxism through the dialectical sublation of its acquis.
